name: gomboc-vscode-extension
description: Find and fix cloud security issues in code and config files

commands.title: Gomboc: Scan current file or scenario
Gomboc: Third Party Compare – Verify targeted Checkov checks (Docker)

gomboc-vscode-extension.apiKey.description: API Key for accessing the server.

gomboc-vscode-extension.scanOnFileSave.description: Scan file every time file saves if true

gomboc-vscode-extension.defaultBranchNam.description: Default main branch for reporting purposes

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlRulesServiceU.description: Rules service URL for ORL. If empty, uses https://rules.app.gomboc.ai

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlRulesServiceT.description: Rules service token for ORL authentication

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlChannel.description: Channel name to pull rules from the rules service. If empty, uses account-based channel (${accountId}/accounts/default) or falls back to 'default'

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlDebugKeepTemp.description: Debug: keep the .orl-temp folder after ORL completes so diagnostics can be inspected.

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlDebugPersistD.description: Debug: copy .orl-temp/.orl/diagnostics artifacts to <workspace>/.orl-debug/last-run before cleanup.

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlTwoPassEnable.description: Experimental: run a fast first pass with ORL hooks disabled to discover which rules actually produce changes, then rerun ORL with only those rules + hooks enabled. This can significantly speed up scans on some Windows/Docker setups.

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlScanTimeoutSe.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for each ORL Docker remediate step before failing the scan.

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlLocalDevRules.description: DEV ONLY: when enabled, if the scanned workspace contains .orl-dev-rules/, inject it as an extra ORL rulespace for local testing.

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlCustomRulesOn.description: DEV ONLY: When enabled, ORL remediation uses only the custom rules folder path below. In this mode, channel pulls and .orl-dev-rules injection are disabled.

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlCustomRulesPa.description: DEV ONLY: Custom ORL rules folder path used when orlCustomRulesOnly is enabled. Supports absolute paths and ${workspaceFolder}.

gomboc-vscode-extension.orlFixAppliedAna.description: Emit analytics to integrations service when an ORL fix is applied.

gomboc-vscode-extension.integrationsServ.description: Integrations service URL for reporting ORL scan results

gomboc-vscode-extension.logLevel.description: Controls extension logging verbosity. Use 'debug' only when diagnosing issues (it can be very noisy).

gomboc-vscode-extension.profilingEnabled.description: Emit structured timing logs to help diagnose scan performance. Filter logs by the marker string GOMBOC_PROFILING::V1::TIMING_EVENT.

gomboc-vscode-extension.checkovContainer.description: Docker image to use for Third Party Compare targeted Checkov verification.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.lint: eslint src __mocks__ --ignore-pattern "test-_development/**" && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.test: npm run test:units && npm run test:integration
